records.title: Downsized and Compromised?: Assessing the Faithfulness of Model Compression
records.reason: The study evaluates pruning and quantization on conventional ANN classifiers for COMPAS, trauma and employment datasets, proposing agreement and subgroup-bias/chi-squared metrics. It finds high aggregate accuracy can hide behavior/fairness shifts after compression. It is useful as general compression evaluation context, but contains no language model or LLM inference/serving method, making the connection weak.

records.title: On Structured State-Space Duality
records.reason: SSM/attention mathematical duality analysis; no specific inference-efficiency method or deployment evaluation.

records.title: SimST: Simulation Framework for Energy-Dataflow Co-Optimization in Spike-Driven Transformer
records.reason: Spiking-transformer simulation/dataflow for vision workloads; distinct spiking/vision architecture, not LLM inference.

records.title: Stability of In-Context Learning: A Spectral Coverage Perspective
records.reason: Studies in-context learning stability and prompt-size estimation, not model inference efficiency.

records.title: HEAL-Summ: a lightweight and ethical framework for accessible summarization of health information
records.reason: HEAL-Summ is a longitudinal health-news summarization and ethics/evaluation pipeline using Phi-3, Qwen 2.5 and Llama 3.2. It processes a 30k+ article corpus and emphasizes local/on-device low-cost deployment; evaluation focuses on semantic similarity, readability, diversity, tone and toxicity. It does not introduce or benchmark a model compression, inference-kernel, throughput or latency improvement; its connection is deployment of small LLMs in an application, so borderline.
